items.title: How AI Is Reshaping Data Center Fiber Networks
items.summary: AI is putting new demands on data center networks. See how multicore, hollow-core and G.654.E fiber technologies can deliver the capacity, density and low latency needed for the next generation of infrastructure.

items.title: Here's one fiber network builder who doesn't leave communities behind
items.summary: While some hyperscalers won't build fiber off-ramps to towns and cities that its fiber passes on the way to data centers, Light Source does the opposite.

items.title: AWS and Microsoft launch multicloud networking in preview
items.summary: AWS to Azure connectivity is now available in preview in four Microsoft cloud regions, with plans to expand.
